paragraphs: In Ireland, workers can get some money tax-free when they stop working. The limit is 200,000 euro in a lifetime.
But there is a gap in the rules. Some people used the tax-free allowance twice. They used it once when they lost their job. Then they used it again when they retired.
They did this by moving their pension into a special account called a PRSA. The old rules did not cover these accounts.
Experts say only a small number of people did this. Some did it by mistake.
The Government will now close the gap in the Finance Bill. The new rules should start on 1 January 2027.
sentZh: 在愛爾蘭，勞工停止工作時可以領取一些免稅的錢。
一生的上限是二十萬歐元。
但規定中有一個漏洞。
有些人兩次使用了這筆免稅額度。
他們在失業時用了一次。
然後在退休時又用了一次。
他們的做法是把退休金轉進一種叫 PRSA 的特別帳戶。
舊規定沒有涵蓋這些帳戶。
專家說只有少數人這樣做。
有些人是無意間這麼做的。
政府現在將在財政法案中堵住這個漏洞。
新規定預計在 2027 年 1 月 1 日開始實施。

paragraphs: The Government plans to close a tax loophole that let some workers get a tax-free lump sum twice. Workers in Ireland can receive up to €200,000 tax-free in their lifetime from redundancy payments and pensions.
When a worker uses part of this tax-free amount on a redundancy payment, they must sign a form. The form says they have already used it. But this form only covers their pension from that job.

Because of this, some people moved their pension into a Personal Retirement Savings Account, or PRSA. These accounts were not covered by the form, so they could take a tax-free lump sum again when they retired. This has been possible since PRSAs started in 2002.
Experts say the number of people who did this is probably small. Jim Connolly of Goodbody said some people may have done it by accident. Munro O'Dwyer of PwC said others moved their money on purpose.
The Finance Bill will now cover PRSAs and other modern pension products. The change is expected to start on 1 January 2027.
sentZh: 政府計畫堵住一個讓部分勞工能兩次領取免稅一次性款項的稅務漏洞。
愛爾蘭勞工一生中可從遣散費和退休金領取最多二十萬歐元的免稅款項。
當勞工把部分免稅額度用在遣散費上時，必須簽一份表格。
表格上說明他們已經用過這部分額度。
但這份表格只涵蓋他們在那份工作的退休金。
因此，有些人把退休金轉入個人退休儲蓄帳戶（PRSA）。
這些帳戶不受表格約束，所以他們退休時可以再領一次免稅的一次性款項。
自 2002 年 PRSA 推出以來，這種做法一直可行。
專家說這樣做的人數可能不多。
Goodbody 的吉姆·康諾利說，有些人可能是無意間這麼做的。
PwC 的芒羅·歐德懷爾說，其他人則是故意轉移資金。
財政法案現在將把 PRSA 和其他新型退休金產品納入規範。
這項改變預計於 2027 年 1 月 1 日開始實施。

paragraphs: The Government is set to close a loophole that has allowed some workers to claim the tax-free lump-sum allowance twice. Under current rules, people can receive up to €200,000 tax-free over their lifetime from redundancy payments and pension savings combined.
If part of that allowance is used on a termination payment, the worker must sign a waiver confirming it has been spent. However, the waiver applies only to the pension linked to that particular job.

This created a gap. Some people transferred their pension into a Personal Retirement Savings Account (PRSA), which was not covered by the waiver, and then claimed a second tax-free lump sum at retirement. The opening has existed since PRSAs were introduced in 2002.

Advisers believe relatively few people benefited. Jim Connolly, head of pensions at Goodbody, said some may have done so unintentionally, while Munro O'Dwyer of PwC said the grey area involves those who deliberately moved funds to exploit it.

The Finance Bill will extend the waiver to PRSAs and other modern pension products, including foreign plans. Subject to the Bill being passed, the change is expected to take effect from 1 January 2027.
sentZh: 政府即將堵住一個讓部分勞工能兩度申領免稅一次性款項額度的漏洞。
根據現行規定，民眾一生中從遣散費與退休儲蓄合計可領取最多二十萬歐元的免稅款項。
如果部分額度用在離職補償金上，勞工必須簽署一份棄權聲明，確認該額度已經用掉。
然而，這份棄權聲明只適用於與那份特定工作相關的退休金。
這就產生了漏洞。
有些人把退休金轉入不受棄權聲明約束的個人退休儲蓄帳戶（PRSA），然後在退休時再申領一次免稅一次性款項。
自 2002 年推出 PRSA 以來，這個漏洞就一直存在。
顧問們認為受益的人相對較少。
Goodbody 退休金部門主管吉姆·康諾利說，有些人可能是無意的；PwC 的芒羅·歐德懷爾則說，灰色地帶涉及那些刻意轉移資金來鑽漏洞的人。
財政法案將把棄權聲明的範圍擴大到 PRSA 及其他新型退休金產品，包括海外計畫。
在法案通過的前提下，這項改變預計自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起生效。

paragraphs: The Government is poised to shut a loophole that has enabled some workers to avail of the tax-free lump-sum allowance twice over. At present, individuals may draw down up to €200,000 free of tax across their lifetime, combining redundancy payouts and pension savings.

Anyone who applies part of that allowance to a termination payment must sign a waiver acknowledging it has been used. Crucially, though, the waiver is confined to the pension attached to that specific employment.

Herein lies the flaw. By shifting their pension into a Personal Retirement Savings Account (PRSA), which fell outside the waiver's scope, some people were able to claim a second tax-free sum on retirement, a manoeuvre that has been feasible ever since PRSAs came into being in 2002.

Advisers reckon the cohort that profited is modest. Jim Connolly of Goodbody suggested some may have benefited inadvertently, whereas Munro O'Dwyer of PwC characterised the deliberate transfer of funds to exploit the gap as a grey area.

The Finance Bill will broaden the waiver to encompass PRSAs and the wider suite of modern pension products, foreign schemes included. Pending enactment, the measure should come into force on 1 January 2027.
sentZh: 政府即將堵住一個讓部分勞工得以兩度享用免稅一次性款項額度的漏洞。
目前，個人一生中結合遣散金與退休儲蓄，最多可提領二十萬歐元而免稅。
任何人若把部分額度用於離職補償金，都必須簽署棄權聲明，承認該額度已被使用。
但關鍵是，這份棄權聲明僅限於與那份特定僱傭關係相連的退休金。
問題正出在這裡。
有些人把退休金轉入不在棄權聲明範圍內的個人退休儲蓄帳戶（PRSA），便能在退休時再申領一筆免稅款項；自 2002 年 PRSA 問世以來，這種操作一直行得通。
顧問們估計從中獲利的群體規模不大。
Goodbody 的吉姆·康諾利暗示有些人可能是無意中受益，而 PwC 的芒羅·歐德懷爾則把刻意轉移資金以利用漏洞的行為形容為灰色地帶。
財政法案將擴大棄權聲明，使其涵蓋 PRSA 以及更廣泛的新型退休金產品，包括海外計畫。
待法案正式通過後，這項措施應於 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。

paragraphs: The Government intends to eliminate a loophole which has enabled certain workers to claim the tax-free lump-sum allowance on two separate occasions. Under existing legislation, individuals are entitled to receive up to €200,000 tax-free over their lifetime from redundancy payments and pension savings combined.

Where a portion of this allowance is applied to a termination payment, the employee is required to sign a waiver confirming that it has been utilised. However, this waiver applies exclusively to the pension associated with that particular employment.

Consequently, a significant gap emerged. By transferring their pension to a Personal Retirement Savings Account (PRSA), which was not subject to the waiver, some individuals were able to obtain a second tax-free lump sum upon retirement. This opportunity has existed since PRSAs were established in 2002.

Financial advisers estimate that the number of beneficiaries is relatively limited. Jim Connolly of Goodbody indicated that some may have benefited unintentionally, whereas Munro O'Dwyer of PwC described the deliberate transfer of funds to exploit the gap as a grey area.

The Finance Bill will extend the waiver to encompass PRSAs and a broader range of modern pension products, including foreign schemes. The measure is expected to take effect on 1 January 2027, although this is contingent upon the legislation being enacted.

paragraphs: The Government is set to close a loophole that has allowed some workers to claim the tax-free lump-sum allowance twice. Under current rules, people can receive up to €200,000 tax-free over their lifetime from redundancy payments and pension savings combined.
If part of that allowance is used on a termination payment, the worker must sign a waiver confirming it has been spent. However, the waiver applies only to the pension linked to that particular job.

This created a gap. Some people transferred their pension into a Personal Retirement Savings Account (PRSA), which was not covered by the waiver, and then claimed a second tax-free lump sum at retirement. The opening has existed since PRSAs were introduced in 2002.

Advisers believe relatively few people benefited. Jim Connolly, head of pensions at Goodbody, said some may have done so unintentionally, while Munro O'Dwyer of PwC said the grey area involves those who deliberately moved funds to exploit it.

The Finance Bill will extend the waiver to PRSAs and other modern pension products, including foreign plans. Subject to the Bill being passed, the change is expected to take effect from 1 January 2027.
